raw:
@q query
  select ?c
  where match
    relation "be the health contribution"
    role subject "a self-employed person"
    role object ?c
    role topic "a net income of 60.000 lei"
    role time "from 1 January"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "apply to"
  role subject "the minimum wage of 4.325 lei"
  role object "the health contribution calculation"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
